encounters.title: The Grotesque Tree (Jove garden)
encounters.source_heading: Appendix A / Grotesque Tree; site tactics Area 5
encounters.summary: The grotesque tree that erupted from the planted conk dominates the Jove garden and threatens the family home. It attacks anything that comes close and hurls rocks at anything that hurts it from afar.

combatants.name: Grotesque Tree
combatants.key_actions: Branch +5 (reach 60 ft., 1d4+3) · Rock +1 (30/120 ft., 1d6+1) · Snare (DC 13 Dex/Str, grapple + suspend 20 ft.) · Sling (DC 13 Dex, 3d6, throw 60 ft.)

mechanics_notes: Huge plant, unaligned · STR 17 (+3) DEX 9 (−1) CON 15 (+2) INT 7 (−2) WIS 10 (+0) CHA 10 (+0)
Damage immunities piercing · resistances bludgeoning · vulnerabilities fire
Condition immunities charmed · blindsight 600 ft. (blind beyond), passive Perception 10
Snare: grapples up to two targets; at start of its turn pulls a grappled target 10 ft. closer to its stem
tactics: Ceases hostilities once no longer under imminent threat

encounters.title: Rampage of the Caretakers
encounters.area: Hempholm surface streets (after the tree dies)
encounters.summary: Hours after the surface tree dies, the caretakers — root-beetle plant minions from below — swarm the village, attacking villagers and structures before returning underground.

combatants.name: Caretakers (bind: twig blight, MM 32)
combatants.key_actions: Mechanics bind to the existing twig blight statblock (MM 32) by reference — not reproduced here

mechanics_notes: Mechanics binding: twig blight (MM 32) — referenced, not copied; no new statblock is invented
tactics: Strike hours after the surface tree dies (during celebration or firefighting)
Return underground after a few hours, or flee once 15 are dead
Treasure: each corpse yields 1 gp of quality root-wood to someone with woodcarver's or carpenter's tools

encounters.title: The Guardian of the Marrow
encounters.summary: In the plant-metal structure beneath Hempholm, the guardian — a large root construct — stands watch over the Marrow with two caretakers.

combatants.name: Guardian
combatants.key_actions: Multiattack (2 melee) · Iron Spike +4 (1d6+2, pin: DC 7 Dex or speed 0; DC 10 Str to remove) · Adamantine Helix Barrage (Recharge 5–6): 15 ft. radius, DC 13 Dex, 1d10 piercing, AC −1 until long rest

combatants.name: Caretakers (bind: twig blight, MM 32)
combatants.key_actions: Mechanics bind to the existing twig blight statblock (MM 32) by reference — not reproduced here

mechanics_notes: Guardian: Large plant, unaligned · STR 15 (+2) DEX 12 (+1) CON 17 (+3) INT 10 (+0) WIS 15 (+2) CHA 10 (+0)
Saving throws Str +4, Con +5 · skills Perception +4
Vulnerabilities fire · resistances piercing · condition immunities charmed
Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14 · Limited Iron Spikes: four spikes, regrow after a long rest
tactics: The guardian defends the Marrow with 2 caretakers at its side
Helix Barrage trades defense for offense — each use lowers its AC by 1 until a long rest
